_comment: Copy this file to <name>.agent.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Delete the fields you do not need. Only name, prompt (or prompt_file) and tools are required.
name: my-crewmate
_comment_name: The crewmate's name in Crew. Also the default agent file name (~/.kiro/agents/<name>.json) if it is a valid file name. Cannot be 'default'.
_comment_kiro_agent: Optional. The agent file name when name has spaces or other characters a file name cannot have. Letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'. Cannot start with 'kirocrew' or be plan/spec/vibe/quick-spec/bug-fix/autonomous.
description: One line: what this crewmate does.
triggers: When to use this crewmate. Crew's orchestrator reads this to choose a crewmate. Empty means it is never offered.
_comment_model: The model used when crewctl.json says plan: free. Run `crewctl models` for the list. On the free plan crewctl rejects paid-only models.
_comment_paid_model: Optional. The model used when crewctl.json says plan: paid. Lets you pick the paid model now and switch machines by changing one setting.
_comment_reasoning_effort: Empty, or low / medium / high / xhigh / max. Only reasoning-capable models use it.
_comment_prompt: Use "prompt": "text" for a short prompt, or prompt_file for a file inside this folder. Exactly one of the two.
_comment_tools: Required. The tools this crewmate may use. [] means none. "*" means all, including write and shell (crewctl warns).
_comment_allowed_tools: Optional. Tools that run without asking for approval.
_comment_mcp_servers: Optional. {"name": {"command": "...", "args": [], "env": {}}} or {"name": {"url": "..."}}. Never put real tokens here; crewctl rejects them.
_comment_crew_servers: Optional. ["core"] lets this crewmate spawn other crewmates, send messages and use Crew memory; ["cron"] adds schedules. crewctl looks up the command on the machine it runs on. Or {"core": {"disabledTools": ["task_run"]}} to hide tools. Give it only to crewmates that need it.
_comment_skills: Optional. Paths to SKILL.md files, for example [".kiro/skills/log-triage/SKILL.md"]. Each becomes a skill:// entry in resources. Custom agents don't load skills unless listed here.
_comment_workspace: The Crew workspace this crewmate works in. workspace_dir is only used when the workspace does not exist yet.
